author: r1-L3
rationale: Hand-written grammar LM as a hierarchical MoE. Trunk clusters: lexical prefix units over ctx (which lexicon words the current partial word could be), a completed-word class detector, and a one-hot pushdown-style clause-state transition (phase, NP role, determiner number, pending main-verb number, pending relative-clause verb numbers). Router sends each position to an NP expert (det/adj/noun), a post-noun expert (verbs/preps/that), a clause-tail expert (adverbs/and/clause end) or a punctuation expert. Lexical experts mix hand-set word probabilities through the prefix units and a piecewise-linear log.
